analysis: Pseudotumour cerebri, also known as idiopathic intracranial hypertension, can be associated with the use of tetracycline antibiotics. Tetracycline has been documented to cause increased intracranial pressure, leading to symptoms similar to those of a brain tumor. The other options listed (Sparfloxacin, Gentamicin, and Clofazimine) are not commonly associated with this condition.
